changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Reprise des signatures en circuits, validateurs et décisions.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO ${database.defaultSchemaName}.circuit (id, document_id, regle_workflow_id, statut, ouvert_le, clos_le, initiateur_id) SELECT ${database.defaultSchemaName}.uuid_v7(), d.id, max(n.regle_workflow_id::text)::uuid, CASE WHEN bool_or(s.status = 'REJECTED') THEN 'REFUSE' WHEN bool_and(s.status = 'SIGNED') THEN 'VALIDE' ELSE 'EN_COURS' END, min(coalesce(s.created_at, now())), CASE WHEN bool_and(s.status = 'SIGNED') THEN max(s.signed_at) END, (SELECT u.id FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.utilisateur u WHERE u.employe_id = d.created_by_employe_id) FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.workflow_ged_signature s JOIN ${database.defaultSchemaName}.document d ON d.id = s.document_id JOIN ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud n ON n.id = d.noeud_principal_id GROUP BY d.id

INSERT INTO ${database.defaultSchemaName}.circuit_validateur (id, circuit_id, employe_id, libelle, position) SELECT s.id, c.id, s.employe_id, coalesce(nullif(btrim(s.step_label), ''), 'Validation'), s.step_order FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.workflow_ged_signature s JOIN ${database.defaultSchemaName}.circuit c ON c.document_id = s.document_id

INSERT INTO ${database.defaultSchemaName}.decision (id, circuit_validateur_id, version_id, decision, motif, cree_le, auteur_id) SELECT ${database.defaultSchemaName}.uuid_v7(), s.id, (SELECT v.id FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document v WHERE v.document_id = s.document_id AND v.courante), CASE s.status WHEN 'SIGNED' THEN 'VALIDE' ELSE 'REFUSE' END, CASE WHEN s.status = 'REJECTED' THEN coalesce(nullif(btrim(s.motif), ''), 'Refus repris sans motif') ELSE s.motif END, coalesce(s.signed_at, s.updated_at, s.created_at, now()), (SELECT u.id FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.utilisateur u WHERE u.employe_id = s.employe_id) FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.workflow_ged_signature s WHERE s.status IN ('SIGNED', 'REJECTED')

rollback.sql: CREATE TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.workflow_ged_signature ( id UUID NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_workflow_ged_signature PRIMARY KEY, document_id UUID NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_workflow_ged_signature_document REFERENCES ${database.defaultSchemaName}.document (id), employe_id UUID NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_workflow_ged_signature_employe REFERENCES ${database.defaultSchemaName}.employe (id), step_label VARCHAR(255), step_order INTEGER NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_workflow_ged_signature_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'REJECTED', 'SIGNED')), signed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, motif VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)

INSERT INTO ${database.defaultSchemaName}.workflow_ged_signature (id, document_id, employe_id, step_label, step_order, status, signed_at, motif, created_at) SELECT cv.id, c.document_id, cv.employe_id, cv.libelle, cv.position, CASE (SELECT d.decision FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.decision d WHERE d.circuit_validateur_id = cv.id ORDER BY d.cree_le DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'VALIDE' THEN 'SIGNED' WHEN 'REFUSE' THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, (SELECT d.cree_le FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.decision d WHERE d.circuit_validateur_id = cv.id ORDER BY d.cree_le DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT left(d.motif, 255) FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.decision d WHERE d.circuit_validateur_id = cv.id ORDER BY d.cree_le DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT 1), c.ouvert_le FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.circuit_validateur cv JOIN ${database.defaultSchemaName}.circuit c ON c.id = cv.circuit_id WHERE c.statut <> 'ANNULE' AND cv.employe_id IS NOT NULL
